unique.fix: Add a carried-seeds column to the §6.1 profile table and to §3.9: 40/60/100 original seeds, at most 1 per 25 lines, one shadow seed per fix, plus the size of the escape-library cohort. Label these as the values behind §3.12. State that seed catches never reset the quiet count.

unique.title: The reviewer composition per profile cannot be executed as written and does not match the composition profile_sim.py models
unique.fix: Add a per-profile slot table to §3.8 and §6.1 that matches LITE8/STD16/FULL24: Opus, Fable, OpenAI and Google at 2, 4 and 6 slots each, naming the strategies each pair runs. Change the Full precondition to 'OpenAI and Google each sustain 6 reviewers a round'. Require the frontier slot in every round for the table to apply, or add a no-Fable simulation row.

unique.title: A 'yes, and one more thing' reply passes every re-ask layer: the Stop check polices only a 'no', Read stays open, and the relay test passes when the relay is unchanged
unique.fix: Make the Stop check independent of polarity. In a completeness or pushback turn, block any reply that names an item, location or row that is not on the certificate. Deny every tool except a whitelisted certificate read. Make the relay test fail on any appended item, and add hand-reviewed yes-plus-item replies as must-block fixtures.

unique.title: Conviction 'derived from a tally' has no defined function, and the evidence ladder gives no required level for document-sourced or reasoning claims, so gate row 5 and the §3.5 routing cannot be evaluated
unique.fix: In §3.5, define a deterministic tally-to-conviction rule. For example, a decision is ruled at 90 or above only when every load-bearing premise of the chosen option is at its required tier and its what-would-flip probe ran negative. Add required levels for spec, standard and law claims and for reasoning claims. Add the rule to the pilot kit's gate.sh.

unique.title: The §3.12 table silently assumes a fix-born rate of b=0.1 and N0=10-20, and calibration measures neither, although cap-hit and residuals change 1.5-3x when b is between 0.1 and 0.5
unique.fix: State b=0.1 and the N0 values as assumed inputs in the Base definition. Add sensitivity rows at b=0.3 and b=0.5. Add the fix-born rate and holes-at-freeze to the §6.6 calibration list.

unique.title: Gate row 8 ('0 cited paths outside the repo') fails every program that does the required private-store mining (memory, transcripts, msg)
unique.fix: Allow uncommitted ~-rooted private receipts that carry a content hash checked at gate time. Ban only /tmp and other volatile paths. Name the repo that holds a greenfield program's records.

unique.title: The research block needs an unlisted operator-run settings.json migration (there is no Workflow matcher), and the router's classifier has no latency bound or fail mode inside a 5 s advisory hook
unique.fix: List the settings.json registration as an operator-run migration in wave 1. Specify the classifier's model, latency bound and fail mode, and set a hook timeout that fits, or run the classification asynchronously.

unique.title: Three-vendor readiness is first needed in Stage 1 but checked only in Stage 3, gemini auth has never been exercised by a real call, and gate row 13 has no rule for a dead vendor lane
unique.fix: Add an intake precondition: one real call per vendor, with the model id recorded, before the contract page. Define the dead-lane rule (the round does not count and the program pauses, or a specified degraded certificate applies), and make row 13 consistent with it.

unique.title: In a greenfield project the frame is signed before the architecture decisions that define its populations, and nothing expands it before the freeze
unique.fix: After each Stage 4 ruling level, add a bounded frame-expansion step. It adds the chosen option's sub-decisions, populations, write paths and premises as frame rows and runs them through Stages 2-3 before the freeze. Cap its depth, price it into the ceiling, and evaluate gate rows 1, 2 and 5 on the expanded frame.

unique.title: The Standard profile's 8-day stage budget contradicts the only evidence prior for a program of that size (11.5 agent-days), which brings forward the overrun trigger that force-defaults open rows
unique.fix: Price Standard from the SYNTHESIS §10.2 prior (about 11.5 days for stages 1-6, about 14 days typical), recompute its ceiling, and move Full up. Otherwise, cite the evidence for the 8-day and 4.25-day figures or mark them as unsupported priors.

unique.title: A frame omission found during certification is queued until after the certificate, outside the signed post-certificate activity list and gate row 1, with no rubric clause and no build-wave gate
unique.fix: Add rubric clause (g): a missing decision, acceptance row or component that a frame row depends on is always material. Define one bounded frame-delta cycle (Stages 2-5 for the delta only, timeboxed and priced, then re-freeze as vN+1). Past its cap, print the omission as a known row that gates the dependent build waves. Add the cycle to the §3.1 list and reconcile it with gate row 1.

unique.title: The re-ask block depends on a classifier whose recall is never measured, and any unclassified or errored prompt fails open
unique.fix: In a certified-program session, deny research-buying tools by default unless the prompt is positively labeled a work order or a reopen. Treat errors, timeouts and mixed labels as completeness. Add a held-out paraphrase recall threshold as a gate row, and retitle §4.2 to say what it actually guarantees.

unique.title: Re-ask routing keys only on cwd or DoD and drops the design's lookup by program name from any pane
unique.fix: Also resolve the program from its registered name or alias in the prompt, and fall back to it when only one program is active. Add an off-cwd phrasing to the 20-trial relay test.

unique.title: The ceiling formula prices certification round 1 at 4.5 h, but the cited source says it takes about 1 day
unique.fix: Change the term to '1 day + (hard cap − 1) × 4.5 h', then recompute the ceilings (about 11, 21 and 28 days) and the Certification column.
